entities.summary: Inger Brattström was a Swedish writer. She was the winner of the Nils Holgersson Plaque in 1967. She is the author of more than 40 books, among them the Dutch translated book Unn en de grotten. Many of her books have been translated into German.

entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Inger Brattström was a Swedish writer. She was the winner of the Nils Holgersson Plaque in 1967. She is the author of more than 40 books, among them the Dutch translated book Unn en de grotten. Many of her books have been translated into German.
